title: Stack Games
tagline: Build tension, one layer at a time.
shortDescription: A one-button stacking challenge where timing and nerve decide how high the tower grows. Easy to start, hard to master, and made for repeat play.
longDescription: A family of stacking games where players drop, align, or balance pieces to build the highest possible tower. A single button or a few simple controls are all it takes, so anyone can play in seconds, while the growing risk of a collapse keeps everyone watching. The pieces, tower, and backdrop can become products, brand objects, or themed props, and the format scales from a quick solo round on a screen to team play with real physical blocks. Score, level, and time are shown live for a natural leaderboard. BRDGE handles the interaction logic, scene management, and journey, leaderboard, and data links end to end.

highlights.title: One Button, Instant Play
highlights.description: Players get it in a second: press at the right moment and the piece lands. That makes it an easy fit for a sponsor booth, a retail aisle, or a museum corner, with no staff needed to explain it.

highlights.title: Stack It Any Way
highlights.description: Run it as a classic digital tower, a falling-blocks puzzle, a team challenge with two players at once, or a physical version where visitors stack real blocks in front of the screen.

highlights.title: Stack Anything, Anywhere
highlights.description: Stack bricks into a jungle temple, rings onto a Wild West post, tires in a racing pit, or the client's own products into a branded tower. Same game, entirely different world.

highlights.title: Every Level on Record
highlights.description: Add a data layer that records plays, heights reached, levels, and repeat attempts, and turn it into a daily leaderboard or a prize threshold that proves how long visitors stayed engaged.

highlights.title: Part of the Game Zone
highlights.description: Pair with MultiPlay Game Station to add physical buttons and pedals, with Visitor Identificator to save each player's best score, with Live Feed to put the leaderboard on the big screen, or with Prize Draw to reward the highest towers.
